Methodology for modeling complex, stateful, interruptible/resumable flows into testable, reusable models
Solid engineering practice: modular architecture, component design, unit and E2E testing, CI/CD, shared library versioning and rollout
Proficient with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor / Claude Code / Copilot) in daily workflows
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for production issues, compatibility problems, performance bottlenecks
Fluency in Mandarin to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders
Additional languages beyond Mandarin are an advantage
